contract.note: Substantial spending on corrective human work through publication is a fair ordinary reading. Requiring expenditure evidence and scale context is reasonable without inventing a numerical threshold.

reviews.rationale: One reported partnership value cannot establish or refute substantial industry expenditure on corrective labor. The packet lacks realized spending totals, broader company coverage and budget context. A small individual contract does not demonstrate that aggregate spending was minor.
